verdict.rationale: Jev is an HTTP API (`POST /v1/systemone`) with Python and JS/TS SDKs, so it runs headlessly by design. Automation is supported by a sync/async client, default retry with backoff on 429s, a programmatic `GET /v1/models` endpoint, and version pinning for reproducible runs. A hands-on community report describes wiring the API into a real-time loop, which corroborates unattended programmatic use. Missing for 10: a CI-specific guide or examples, a first-party CLI, documented non-interactive auth (API key or env var) setup, and independent reports of CI pipeline usage.
